exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Information Repositories
exploitedBy.relevance: Misclassifying performance data as non-sensitive exposes information repositories to unauthorized access and collection by threat actors.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Stored Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Incorrectly labeled sensitive performance data in storage is at risk of manipulation if not properly protected through classification controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Absence of lifecycle-triggered deletion policies directly enables excessive retention of performance data beyond operational need.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Staged
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessively retained data accumulates in staged storage locations, increasing the attack surface for unauthorized data collection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Without encryption at rest, metrics stored in cloud storage can be accessed and exfiltrated by adversaries exploiting misconfigured permissions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Windows File and Directory Permissions Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly broad read permissions on performance records reflect improper access control settings that attackers can exploit or that expose data to unauthorized users.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Permission Groups Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Adversaries can discover overly permissive groups with read access to raw performance records to identify targets for data collection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
exploitedBy.relevance: Sharing unanonymized performance data across teams exposes identifiable information that adversaries or insiders can harvest for reconnaissance.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Business Relationships
exploitedBy.relevance: Cross-team sharing without anonymization can inadvertently reveal organizational relationships and sensitive operational details to unintended parties.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
exploitedBy.relevance: Non-compliant cross-border transfers of sensitive metrics mirror the technique of transferring data to external cloud accounts outside authorized boundaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Scheduled Transfer
exploitedBy.relevance: Scheduled automated transfers of operationally sensitive metrics across borders without compliance checks align with this exfiltration scheduling technique.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthorized cross-border data transfers may use alternative protocols to bypass data loss prevention and compliance controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Destruction
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal procedures fail to ensure proper destruction of decommissioned datasets, leaving sensitive performance data recoverable.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Proper secure file deletion procedures are critical during decommissioning; absence of these controls leaves residual data exposed.
